relations.rationale: If Dara arrived shortly after Ivo and Uma, that leaves open whether Otto arrived even later, but doesn't confirm Otto arrived last.
Dara's arrival timing relative to Ivo and Uma doesn't bear on Otto's jogging to catch up.
Dara's early arrival timing is unrelated to whether everyone reassembled by midmorning.
Having a field guide under one's arm has no bearing on relative height of Pia and Otto.
Dara carrying a field guide is unrelated to which teams Ivo and Uma were on.
Dara having a field guide has no logical connection to a heron sighting the previous week.
Dara's field guide has nothing to do with Otto's age relative to Pia.
Dara carrying a field guide is unrelated to Uma's laughing about a kingfisher.

Relative heights of Pia and Otto have no connection to a heron sighting near a bridge.
Height comparison between Pia and Otto is unrelated to the number of teams.
Pia being taller than Otto has no bearing on everyone sharing water.
Height comparison is unrelated to age comparison between Otto and Pia.
Pia's height relative to Otto has no bearing on Otto's age relative to Ivo.
Dara's height relative to Pia and Otto has no bearing on Uma nodding in agreement.
Dara's height compared to Pia and Otto is unrelated to Otto's age relative to Pia.

Otto bringing a first-aid kit has no bearing on whether Ivo and Uma were on different teams.
Otto bringing the first-aid kit doesn't relate to him jogging to catch up with others.
